name: testpilot
description: TestPilot — AI-assisted web testing platform with automatic missing-test discovery and bug reporting.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:setup && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web,shop -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev -w @testpilot/server" "npm run dev -w @testpilot/web" "npm run dev -w @testpilot/demo-shop"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @testpilot/server && npm run typecheck -w @testpilot/web
